vocab.definition: more particles per volume → more collisions.
more energy → faster, more successful collisions.
smaller pieces → more area to collide with.

misconceptions.right: Heating gives particles more energy, not more particles.
Smaller pieces have more surface area → faster.

misconceptions.wrong: Concentration changes the amount of product.
misconceptions.right: It changes the rate, not the final amount.

infoPanels.title: PARTICLES & COLLISIONS
infoPanels.secondaryContent: More frequent, higher-energy collisions mean a faster rate.

questions.text: List four factors that affect the rate of reaction. [2 marks]

Explain why powdered marble reacts faster than marble chips. [2 marks]

questions.secondaryText: Raising temperature gives particles more ______, so collisions are more ______.

questions.text: Explain why increasing pressure speeds up a reaction between gases. [2 marks]

footer.tip: Anything that increases the frequency or energy of collisions speeds up the rate.
footer.thinkPrompt: Why does concentration change the rate but not the final mass of product?
